from.place: Step 5: canonical constant comparison and its derived pullback-square coherence.

title: The derived pullback square respects canonical constant comparisons
statement: Let A be any commutative ring, let e:U→X and w:X′→X be arbitrary scheme morphisms, and form the chosen pullback with p=fst: X′×_X U→X′ and q=snd: X′×_X U→U [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let c_f:D(f*)(A_[target][0])≅A_[source][0] be the canonical constant isomorphism [def-pur-etale-sum-exchange-constant-iso] in the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. With chi:e*⋙q*≅w*⋙p* the specified sheaf pullback-composition square, D(chi) at A_X[0], followed by D(p*)(c_w) and c_p, equals D(q*)(c_e) followed by c_q. No etaleness, finiteness or Noetherian hypothesis on e, w or A is needed.

proof.text: For arbitrary e:U→X and w:X′→X, set chi = squareUpperStarIso for the chosen pullback. Expand it into the two diagonal composition comparisons. Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso_comp identifies each constant route with the canonical constant comparison along the diagonal. Cancel the invertible diagonal comparison; its commutativity proof is pullback.condition. This yields chi at A_X followed by the w- and fst-constant maps equal to the e- and snd-constant maps. The argument covers identity maps, empty schemes and the zero coefficient ring.

In arbitrary abelian categories, sumSquareSingle follows from mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_hom_app_singleFunctor and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_hom_app_singleFunctor. The naturality of each exact-single comparison on a map c gives sumSquareSingleMaps: any commuting sheaf square remains commuting after exact derivation on the degree-zero object and the specified single comparisons. The proved helper sumSquareSingleIsos rewrites the abstract isomorphism hom projections. Apply it to the four canonical constant-sheaf isomorphisms and the sheaf square of the first step. The composite isomorphisms are exactly the unchanged etaleSumExchangeConstantIso definitions, giving the asserted morphism square.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSumExchangeConstantSquare
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U X X' : Scheme.{u}} (e : U ⟶ X) (w : X' ⟶ X) :
    (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
        (squareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback w e).toCommSq)).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A A))) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst w e)).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (etaleSumExchangeConstantIso A w).hom ≫
      (etaleSumExchangeConstantIso A (pullback.fst w e)).hom =
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd w e)).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (etaleSumExchangeConstantIso A e).hom ≫
      (etaleSumExchangeConstantIso A (pullback.snd w e)).hom
